notes: Cart & checkout overhaul - ticket items are now proper cards with pill qty steppers and tabular money; order-type icons; collapsible order notes and delivery options with live summaries; customer picker with avatars, loyalty pills and full-size search; discount modal with type icons, live peso preview, cap warning and one-tap remove; payment screen two-pane tender with shared numpad, wrapping method chips and an in-app order-complete dialog; product grid polish (clean category labels, single-line price ranges); responsive fixes for narrow carts and landscape tablets; modal accessibility fix.
